# 1 Enoch Chapter 83 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Dreams

---

**83:1** And-now, my-son Methuselah, I-will-show-thee all-my-visions which-I-have-seen, which-I-recount-before-thee.

**83:2** Two-visions I-saw before-I-took-a-wife, and-the-one-was-unlike-the-other: the-first when-I-was-learning-to-write: the-second before-I-took-thy-mother, [when] I-saw-a-terrible-vision. And-regarding-them-I-prayed-to-the-Lord.

**83:3** I-had-lain-down in-the-house-of-my-grandfather Mahalalel, when-I-saw-in-a-vision how-the-heaven-collapsed and-was-borne-off and-fell-to-the-earth.

**83:4** And-when-it-fell-to-the-earth I-saw-how-the-earth-was-swallowed-up-in-a-great-abyss, and-mountains-were-suspended-on-mountains, and-hills-sank-down-on-hills, and-high-trees-were-riven-from-their-stems, and-hurled-down-and-sunk-in-the-abyss.

**83:5** And-thereupon-a-word-fell-into-my-mouth, and-I-lifted-up-[my-voice] to-cry-aloud, and-said: 'The-earth-is-destroyed.'

**83:6** And-my-grandfather Mahalalel-waked-me-as-I-lay-near-him, and-said-to-me: 'Why-dost-thou-cry-so, my-son, and-why-dost-thou-make-such-lamentation?'

**83:7** And-I-recounted-to-him the-whole-vision which-I-had-seen, and-he-said-to-me: 'A-terrible-thing-hast-thou-seen, my-son, and-of-grave-moment-is-thy-dream-vision, and-in-regard-to-the-secrets-of-all-the-sin-of-the-earth: it-must-sink-into-the-abyss-and-be-destroyed-with-a-great-destruction.

**83:8** Now, my-son, arise-and-make-petition-to-the-Lord-of-glory, since-thou-art-a-believer, that-a-remnant-may-remain-on-the-earth, and-that-He-may-not-destroy-the-whole-earth.

**83:9** My-son, from-heaven-all-this-will-come-upon-the-earth, and-upon-the-earth-there-will-be-great-destruction.'

**83:10** After-that-I-arose-and-prayed-and-implored-and-besought, and-wrote-down-my-prayer for-the-generations-of-the-world. And-I-will-show-thee everything, my-son Methuselah.

**83:11** For-when-I-went-out-below and-saw-the-heaven, and-the-sun-rising-in-the-east, and-the-moon-setting-in-the-west, and-a-few-stars, and-the-whole-earth, and-everything-as-He-had-known it-from-the-beginning, I-blessed-the-Lord-of-judgment-and-extolled-Him-because-He-had-made-the-sun-to-go-forth-from-the-windows-of-the-east, and-to-ascend-and-rise-upon-the-face-of-the-heaven, and-set-out-and-keep-traversing-the-path-shown-unto-him.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Ge'ez (Ethiopic) text. Hyphenated compounds preserve Ge'ez construct chains. Chapter 83 opens the Book of Dreams (chs. 83-90). Enoch recounts two visions he had before marriage: the first is the flood vision, seen at his grandfather Mahalalel's house. The cosmic collapse imagery (heaven falling, earth swallowed) anticipates the flood. Mahalalel's counsel to pray for a remnant is key.*
